problem_restatement.observed: V58's BTC long route remained selective because it requires an hourly downside sweep and reclaim. The frozen challenger tested an asset-specific trend pullback and four-bar reacceleration mechanism without changing the live route.
problem_restatement.tested_correction: Require completed one-hour EMA21 above EMA55 context, a completed fifteen-minute pullback, and a four-bar reacceleration; arm for eight bars without refresh; enter on the next one-minute bar; use fixed 60-bps stop and target with a twenty-four-hour fallback.
problem_restatement.result: The challenger generated adequate opportunity but lost after costs in development, validation, and pseudo-holdout, and reduced net PnL while increasing drawdown when competing with the current V58 BTC routes.

decision.reason: Every preregistered validation and pseudo-holdout profitability, largest-winner robustness, stress, shared-route incremental-PnL, and drawdown check failed.

interpretation.high_confidence: The exact frozen trend-pullback/reacceleration specification is unsuitable for live promotion: the negative result replicated independently, spans 147 nominal completed trades, persists under stress, and becomes worse in current-route competition.
interpretation.medium_confidence: The entry mechanism, rather than sparse sampling, is the primary failure because signal frequency was adequate and both win/loss balance and payoff after friction were unfavorable across all partitions.
interpretation.not_established: This result does not falsify every BTC continuation mechanism, does not prove future sweep-control profitability, and one-minute bars cannot establish exact mark/BBO ordering, executable depth, queue position, or sub-minute latency.

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: Independent reconstruction changes any trade row, source hash, partition count, or normalized report result.

The implementation is shown to differ from the preregistered hourly context, fifteen-minute pullback, four-bar reacceleration, eight-bar arm, next-minute entry, 60/60 exits, sizing, fee, funding, or slippage contract.
Exact mark and executable-depth replay reverses the large negative candidate-versus-control ranking.
A future test may update the broader BTC-long assessment only if it uses a materially distinct preregistered mechanism rather than nearby tuning of this rejected family.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.priority: Preserve the positive but selective sweep control and diagnose why the rejected continuation entries failed by regime and path before preregistering one materially distinct BTC-long mechanism.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.excluded: Do not relax the sweep route, tune this frozen trend-pullback family, or transfer HT-Breakout from HYPE.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.success_criteria_before_any_live_proposa: Positive after-cost validation and pseudo-holdout under nominal and stress friction, positive net excluding the largest winner, no worse shared-route drawdown, positive incremental current-V58 BTC net, exact executable-depth feasibility, prospective post-cutoff confirmation, implementation parity, and explicit human approval.

independent_reproduction.verification: Trade sidecars are byte-identical; normalized reports match after excluding generated_at_utc.
